lessons.title: Alphabet and Fingerspelling
lessons.description: Use the existing licensed alphabet reference while keeping J and Z separate from static recognition.
learningObjectives: Recognize the provided label and its development media reference.
Practice one sign at a time without inferring unsupported grammar.
Record uncertainty for FSL review before publication.
lessons.explanation: This development lesson uses FSL-105 source labels and clips. The source label and license are recorded, but the sign/video pairing remains pending visual and FSL-community review.
